source.note: 1996 Flair Baseball is modeled in VCS as the collector-facing 400-card flagship checklist. Every base number was printed in two equal-production foil/background treatments, but VCS intentionally ignores those print variants so completion and prestige require one card per logical checklist number. Promotional Sample and Promo Panels are excluded from the pack product.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 cards per pack, 24 packs per box. The primary physical Hobby configuration was seven cards per pack and 24 packs per box; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule while preserving verified insert denominators.
decisions.baseVariationHandling: TCDB notes two equal-production print treatments for every base card: gold lettering/silver background and silver lettering/gold background. VCS intentionally ignores this distinction. Both physical treatments map to the same logical VCS card number and do not create separate completion/prestige requirements.
decisions.baseScarcity: Neither print treatment is a parallel or hit. The variants are ignored rather than modeled as separate cards or ProductSets.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Append RC only to TCDB-recognized true rookie card numbers. With variants collapsed, VCS contains five RC cards: one logical row for each recognized rookie number.
decisions.insertModeling: Diamond Cuts, Hot Gloves, Powerline, and Wave of the Future are the four verified pack insert sets. Promotional Sample and Promo Panels are excluded as promos.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Pack odds live only on ProductSets. Card Variant does not contain set-wide insertion odds.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject plus RC when verified. TCDB VAR/error/collector metadata remains outside Player.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete logical flagship checklist #1-400. The two equal-production foil/background print treatments are intentionally ignored and do not create separate VCS cards.

productSets.name: Diamond Cuts
productSets.notes: 12-card insert set, numbered 1-12. Physical insertion ratio 1:20 packs.

productSets.name: Powerline
productSets.notes: 10-card insert set, numbered 1-10. Physical insertion ratio 1:6 packs.

productSets.notes: 20-card insert set, numbered 1-20. Physical insertion ratio 1:72 packs.
